topic: Getting a haircut on Saturday morning
passage: Last Saturday morning, I went to a barber shop near my home for a haircut. Although I had planned to go after lunch, I set off early because the shop is often crowded on weekends. When I walked in, a young barber smiled and asked me to take off my jacket. I hung it up and sat down in front of the big mirror. He looked at my hair carefully and asked what style I wanted. I asked for a short cut, but I told him to keep a little length on the top. He covered my shoulders with a black cloth and started to cut. Small pieces of hair fell onto the floor. After twenty minutes, he held up a mirror and asked if I was happy with the result. I looked at the back and nodded. Then I put on my jacket, paid for the haircut, and walked out into the sunlight. On the way home, I stopped at a bakery and picked up some bread for my family. When I showed my wife the new haircut, she laughed and said I looked younger. I promised to go back to the same shop next month.

coach_rationale: 今早用了 Muse 导出的真实 drill 日志和任务定义，并直查了 drill_sessions。EnglishPod365 笔记仍停在第 5–7 周小结（无更新），主弱项仍是动词短语连读（fill me in、kicked me out、pick up a）和过去式 -ed 听辨，所以今天继续埋连读和 -ed 靶子。这篇「周六早上去理发」是全新日常话题，短文里有 20 多个过去式动词，重点练 planned/looked/asked/covered/started/nodded/promised 这类 -ed 结尾；set off、take off、sat down、asked for、put on、paid for、walked out、picked up 是今天的短语动词连读靶子。难度保持听写 B1、跟读 A2。
